description: Find UI elements by selector (e.g. button[name='Save'], text_field[name='Name'][value='x']) in an app's accessibility tree, optionally waiting up to timeout_ms for one to appear. One line per match with a ref for computer::act; never picks a match for you. A find with matches replaces the previous refs. Native macOS/Windows sessions only.

app_name.description: Exact, case-sensitive app name as the OS reports it (macOS: the app name; Windows: the executable name without .exe, e.g. `notepad`, or the window title when the process cannot be opened). Exclusive with `app_pid` and `root_ref`.

app_pid.description: Process id of the app to read (default: the foreground app). Exclusive with `app_name` and `root_ref`.

max_depth.description: Deepest level below the root (the root is level 0), 1-12. Default 6.

root_ref.description: A ref from the current snapshot to read beneath (single attempt). Exclusive with `app_pid` and `app_name`.

selector.description: CSS-like selector: snake_case role, [attr='v'] filters (=, *=, ^=, $=; name, value, description, role and states such as enabled, checked, selected), descendant (space) and child (>) combinators, :nth(n), and comma groups. Example: dialog[name='Save'] button[name='OK'].

timeout_ms.description: Keep looking for up to this many ms until something matches (0-30000, default 0 = one attempt). Not with root_ref.

matches.description: Total matches (may exceed the lines listed).

tree.description: Untrusted app text: a marker line, then one line per match (at most 50) with its ref and up to three named ancestors.

truncated.description: The last walk stopped at its node budget or deadline: zero matches may be a false negative.
